LanguageData.DND_EnableChokePointDetection_Tooltip: When enabled, the mod will detect if a room is the only path between areas and skip locking it to avoid trapping pawns
LanguageData.DND_KeepUnlockedForUrgentTending_Tooltip: When a colonist requires urgent medical care, their room will remain unlocked
LanguageData.DND_KeepUnlockedForSurgery_Tooltip: When a colonist has pending surgery bills, their room will remain unlocked
LanguageData.DND_KeepUnlockedForAnyTending_Tooltip: When a colonist has any tendable health issues, their room will remain unlocked
LanguageData.DND_KeepUnlockedForResearch_Tooltip: When a colonist is actively researching, their room will remain unlocked so they can continue without interruption
LanguageData.DND_KeepLockedForSoloRelaxation_Tooltip: When a colonist is relaxing for joy purposes, lock their room
